Programme background. The screening programme invites members of the enrolled population at fixed intervals. Results are reviewed by a clinician before any follow-up is arranged, and the review note must state the estimated probability of the condition given the result, using the programme's published prevalence figures and the validated test characteristics.
Test validation. Sensitivity and specificity were estimated in a validation study with the reference standard applied to every participant; the study report (version 2) states that the estimates did not differ materially between age groups, so a single pair of values is used for all groups.
Follow-up policy. Where the estimated probability of the condition after the test exceeds 25%, a confirmatory examination is booked within 21 days; otherwise the person is returned to routine recall. The estimate must combine the prior for the person's age group with the test result; it must not be read directly from the sensitivity or specificity.
Programme data sheet: prevalence of the condition in the screened population by age group — under 40: 8 per 1,000, 40 to 59: 20 per 1,000, 60 and over: 40 per 1,000.
Test characteristics (validation study, n = 6,752): sensitivity 95% (share of people with the condition who test positive); specificity 95% (share of people without the condition who test negative). Results are independent of age group given the condition status.

Ximena Olsen, age group 60 and over, screened on 2025-11-17: result POSITIVE. No other risk information is on file.

Clinic note (Vera Kessler): the test is 95% sensitive, so a positive result means about a 95% chance.

question.instructions: Given the result, is it more likely than not that Ximena Olsen has the condition?

criteria.false: The probability of the condition given the result is 50% or less.

rationale: (1) Prior for the 60 and over group: 40 per 1,000 = 0.0400. (2) P(condition and positive) = 0.0400 x 95% = 0.0380. (3) P(no condition and positive) = 0.9600 x 5% = 0.0480. (4) P(condition | positive) = 0.0380 / (0.0380 + 0.0480) = 0.4419. (5) 0.4419 is below 0.5.
